course.tagline: Build real websites and real apps in 30 days, from your first page to a deployed full-stack project.

days.challenge: Add a second page called about.html and link the two pages together.
days.goal: Explain how a browser loads a page and build your first HTML page.

days.challenge: Add a dark section, a skills list and a working contact form to the portfolio.

Responsive layout that works at phone and desktop widths
A projects section with at least three cards
Clean CSS in a separate file, no inline styles on every element
Code pushed to GitHub with clear commit messages
Live Netlify link that opens without errors

video.title: Build a Responsive Website | HTML, CSS Grid, Flexbox & More
